products.description: GARRETT is a ripstop shell jacket made from recycled pre-consumer yarn. Featuring seam sealed interior, water-resistant zipper at the center front and rain shedder at both the front and back for extra protection against the elements. The regular fit silhouette is defined by elasticized cuffs and hem, and a stand collar with a packable hood. Zip pockets throughout and underarm eyelets for ventilation add utilitarian appeal. A refined nod to late 80s sportswear with a functional edge for all season wear.

The relaxed silhouette and soft hand-feel offer everyday ease with a luxurious edge.

products.description: PORTER-K is a casual shirt-style jacket crafted from soft brushed knit organic cotton and recycled polyester. Designed with a classic shirt collar and full button-front closure, it balances structure with laid-back appeal. Adjustable sleeve cuffs and patch pockets with flaps and snaps lend practical versatility. Lightweight and unlined, it offers a polished layering piece for transitional wear.

products.name: Alisandra trench jacket
products.category: ['5598 - Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Outerwear > Coats & Jackets']
products.description: The Alisandra trench jacket is key to transitional dressing. Made from an organic cotton blend, the double-breasted design features epaulettes at the shoulders and buckled sleeve straps. You will find yourself reaching for yours for seasons to come.

products.name: Mackage Agatha Quilted Mixed-media Hooded Jacket In Cream, Size: S
products.description: AGATHA is a fitted, mixed-media jacket with a quilted front body and diamond quilting at the waist. Made from recycled materials and filled with GRS-certified recycled down, it features an adjustable hood with bungee cord and stopper. The double-face jersey sleeves and back enhance comfort, while subtle branding on the sleeve and front zipper complete the design.

products.name: Mackage Aidan-sa Diamond-quilted Bomber Jacket In Black, Size: 42
products.description: AIDAN-SA is a lightweight bomber jacket featuring a diamond-quilted body and satin sleeves and yoke.
